answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the falcon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the mirror of a task receipt, and the lantern is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on liquidity provision incentives with impermanent loss hedging. Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short.
